script: The wreck of the Titanic lies about 3,800 meters below the surface. It was not found until 1985, 73 years after the ship sank. Bacteria are slowly eating away the iron of the wreck. One of these bacteria was even named after the ship: Halomonas titanicae. Some scientists think the wreck could collapse completely within a few decades.
